name: Gelation, emulsion breaking, curing and capsule wash chip
description: Gels the shells in a cold delay line, then breaks the emulsion, photocures and washes the capsules in a trap. Parametric parts: modules gelation_delay, capsule_trap use the nearest library block as a stand-in (real part and sizing in autochip_part / params). build_chip.py builds the stand-ins at library size; the exact chip needs the autochip layout stage.
source: autochip chip plan spc_capsule_workflow_resin_print_multilayer (protocol spc_capsule_workflow, constraints resin_print_multilayer)

modules.does: Gives the emulsion a 30 min cold residence on the cold plate so the shells gel. A low flow keeps the line small enough for the chip.
A 25 um mesh holds the capsules while the breaking agent removes the oil, the photoinitiator is flushed in and 405 nm light cures the shells, and buffer washes them.

steps_text.11: Collect the emulsion and keep it on ice so the shell gels.
steps_text.12: Break the emulsion with an emulsion-breaking agent and remove the oil phase.
steps_text.13: Photocure the capsule shells with 405 nm light in the presence of photoinitiator.
steps_text.14: Wash the capsules in buffer to remove oil and free reagents.
